title: Codex CLI in WKAppBot (howto)
desc: Operate Codex CLI inside WKAppBot: install, modes, sandbox/config, the wkcodex wrapper.
steps: INSTALL: prefer repo-local bin codex.exe; smoke-check codex --help and codex --version; if auth stale run codex login (creds under ~/.codex). RC-SENSITIVE: rc=0 success, rc=1 handled failure, any other rc = investigate even if the terminal looked quiet.
MODES: codex [PROMPT] interactive; codex exec non-interactive automation; codex review for review jobs; codex resume --last / fork --last to continue/branch (resumed runs are separate executions).
REPRODUCIBILITY: -c key=value, --model MODEL (codex-mini cheap / gpt-5 strong), -p PROFILE; config files for defaults, CLI overrides for one-offs.

EXECUTION INTENT: -s read-only / workspace-write / danger-full-access, -a on-request, --full-auto; -C DIR anchors the tree, --add-dir for extra writable roots; --search only when web grounding needed; codex apply to apply the last diff.

WKCODEX WRAPPER (primary method): wkcodex.ps1 'skill-read A. skill-read B. skill-read C. task' -- pre-checks 3+ skill refs + forbidden kill/skill-edit patterns, auto-injects sandbox bypass, post-checks git diff + CP949.
STREAMING: codex exec --json prints JSONL events live; SPEC-GATE: non-mini codex exec needs a SPEC block + 3 skill refs, codex-mini skips both.
author: claude
